zig pa po'i gtam/rang re'i bod du dmangs khrod kha rgyun du ring nas 'jags pa'i gtam dpe ha cang mang po yode kyang de rnams phyogs bsgrigs kyis par du btab pa ni da bar byung med pas/) lam sde dge bskal bzang dbang 'dus dang tor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar rnam gnyis sa phyogs 6da mdzad pa'i gtam dpe zin deb 'di ga dpe skrun khang du par lhan bya rgyur gnang ba :gas/ da phan bod du bta dper dbye ba med par ṇa dpe'am gtam rgyud/ mi bcad la sog pa gang bder brjod pa la rnam gnyis dadangabasta'char du ri rdo klung skyel lta bur rgyud 'jags rig bsdus yi gtam dpe dang / mi ga da byung na chung nas byung / rta gcig yong na rte'u nas yong lta bur nyaca/sa mang don bsdus gyi gtam dpe/ ri bong cal 'drogs lta bur gtam rgyud don bsdus skyu gtam dpe zhes khag gsum tsam du dbye dgos pa gzhir bzung gis thengs 'dir nga tshos nyams mang don bsdus kyi gtam dpe kha gtsang bdams nas 'di gar sngon bsdus kyi gtam dpe nas gang danas kha gsab byas rjes ka kha'i go rim ltar phyogs sgrig byas te par du btab pa /rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis gzigs nas dbye dbyed byed phyogs cad de min byi dkanga'ad'char yod rigs lhug stsal yod pa rta/
642 po 09tsāmatsho ji ga ji ci khu ji5lo ma/ka bar 'jag ma'i lhan pa/ka lis gnam chu bsgugs/sgal tshigs bya mas khongs/ka hor pas brgyab rgyu lhar mos brgyabs/khri bdag pos 'gog rgyu mgron pos bkagkun dang mthun pa mi chos rtsa ba yin/ker pheb sgur gsum gyi bdag po las/lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdom pa dga'/yer sar phyag dang sgur sgur gyi zhu 'bul ka gru snga btsan dang bka' shog rjes bcan/
tshi ba rgacig nas dras pa'i rgyun bu dang /sha khog gcig nas gtubs pa'i tig gako ko g.yag la re mi dgos/rgya tsha glang gi ka ba yod/ko ba skam pos skud mi len/n+tha nga ma rlon pas chu mi len/skyo/ gla sprod rgyu dang /rgyab chu brgal rgyu/ko ba chu la spong ba'i srol yong kyang ༈rdo chu la spangs ba'i bangs srol med/kong po klu nang du slebs dus/a jos pha yul mi dran/dka' las skya bas brgyabs/longs spyod gzar bus btang /
dka' brla brag dang ma thug na/bde ba'i spang la slebs mi thub/dka' las rang gis brgyabs/'ongs rgyud mi yis btang /dka' las brgyabs pa'i dka' chang dang /mdzo pho bsad pa'i sdig gla/dka' las ma brgyabs par dngos grub ga nas yong /dka' ba'i dus su grogs po bzang ngan rtogs/'dam rdzab nang du rta pho'i shed shugs shes/dkar dkar snam bu'i tshos mdog red ma gtogs/khra khra tshon ris kyi g.yab shos ma red/dkar mo nas kyi gong thang chod tshar na/gro dang sran ma'i shong thang zhod ma dgos/
dkar yol chag kyang ri mo zlo la nges/dkar po gyen 'ded dang ’nag po thur 'den/dkon mchog gis lam gang bstan dang /byis pas khyi gang bkag las med pa/dkon gnyer phyis bdar mkhas drag na/gser sku rag la btang yong ngo /dkyil du bzhag na phra 'dra zur du bzhag na rgyan 'dra/bka' drin la bsam shes med par/drin lan la log 'jal/bka' zhog dzo ma pyad rgyal po'i phyag rtsa nga — /mna' ma ka ma skyod ma ma'i 5 rtsa/
bka' rdo rje gcod pa dang /gsung spu gri ngar ma/bka' lan sngon por zhu lan ljang khu/bka' shog rgyab la mi shogbkra gis pa'i thu len sar/ltas ngan pa'i sdug skad/bkra shis pa'i bro khrab sar/ltas ngan pa'i zhab bro ma rgyagbkrol long med nas 'bregs nyan long med nas bshad/rkang bzhi la kha dang ༈ga kyu chung sdo rgyasrkang lag phra par/ —'khur rtsa cad 46
rkang 'og gi de'u/dpral bar 'phar ba/rku rgyus yod kyis byed/rdzun rgyus med kyis shod/rkun ma nang la bzhagsgo lcags phyi la brgyab/rkun ma la dpag pa'i chog shes/rkun ma a yag gis brkus/khabaka 'a ba/bka slo bzhab/rkun ma kha skyong ces mi gsod/khyi kha skyengs kyis chu 'a nga /rkun jag bzung na gte po zungs/rtswa ngan bkag na rtsa ba 'don/rkun ma la dpa' dar dang /spyang gi la tshe pa
rkun pos g.yag la bzhon/g.yag mgos rta rgyug btang /rkun pos khrid pa'i ba mo/kun ma rkun gzog che/rkun ma mi shor ba dgos/rkun rtsad mi chod pa dga'/rkun ma ham chen gyis mi gsod/rkun ma sangs rgyas gar yod mi shes/rkun ma lang shor mi gral la mi tshud/rkun ma la jag pa shor/rkub ba gral la mi tshud/ḍa ru rnga gral la mi tshud/ku mi chog gsung mi dpon po dang ༈rgyu cha nang chen dargas mi dpon po red/
rku sems la bcangs na thob rgyun mi chad/rkyang pho hring la chu mi ragmi pho tsung mi sna mi 'a parkyang la rngo shor na/yas so can gyi bstan par gnod/rkyang lho la shi yang /mgo byang la lta/brkyangs na mda' nyan pa/bkug na gzhu nyan pa/rkyal khog chen po'i zhabs ra/zhugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar/lkugs pas spyang mdog byas pa/mngon gsal gzhan las dod pa/
lhags pas zhugs rtags ma bstan na/༷la po zas dang nor nyan yod/skugs pa la shes ra ke dang /'ong ba la ye shes kyi migskang char cho mi 'dugspud par dbugs mi 'dugmam po rdos rdungs/rlon pa gris gcod/skam po'i lag rtsed de/rlon pa'i chu nang du mi thon/skar ma lnga yi a sgor/su yis btags kyang thogs shigskar ma re res nam re bskyal/de nas tho rengs skar chen shar/sna /sa ka med par thog khar mi slebs/
gas kur srang gang sprus na/thog khar ci 'jogṭu stod la bstod ra dang /sku smad la smad ra/sku lus gcig la bkod pa brgya/skud pa ring po lam la zad/mi tshe ring po stong par zad/me de las ring na yi dwags dang /gting de las ring na dmyal ba/ske khyer nas zhags pa nyo ba dang /rdza khyer nas rdo nyo ba/྅ 'dod la lnga ba mi 'dod/sko 'bregs nas dbog mar byil byil/skad rag las sne 'dzar ring ba/10
mad rag ma nga shis dpyid mas/'i gdeng skom dus chang gis ma phan na/rdza ma'i them bu brdol kyang brdol/skya ga khra mo'i tshang gcig nas/ma khra bu nag yong don med/skya ga la mdzes pa dang /thang shing la spam pa/myaka pa skam po chus khyer kyang /sde pa bzhung gis ko ba mi gtong /skyag 66 skad cha'i 'gro phyobs/mna' skyekhu/ bsam don 'grub ched/skyed kyis sdug nyos/mar gyis tshal nyos/
skyid sdug zhu sa dpon po dang /grang lhogs shod sa pha ma/skyed pa'i re ba byas kyang ༈sdug gi 'phrang las mi thar/skyid po'i kha bshad de/sdug po'i skyo rogs mi yong /skyid thag ring ba'i thabs dang ༈sdug thag thung ba'i blo dgos/skyid po la sgug long dang ༈sdug po la sangs dus yod/skyid po zhwa pho'i rwa las ring ༈sdug po dgo pho'i brun las mang /skyed nyi ma gnyis la shar dus med/sdug mun pa gnyis la sel dus yod/12
cad na nam mkha'i bya yang 'khor/6ga na rang gi bu yang bros/skyid la khag rtswa 2 ca/nyam za dang ༈—sdug ko long chu la mnya ma 'thung /skyed na ja chatsha mnyam 'thang ༈sdub/ na rang se mas gso rogs/skyid na ma ca r+nghi sdu dang ༈sdug rna 6 teji zagskyid por nyis rtsegs med pa'i/sdug por gsum rtsegs/ngaskyid po rang gis ma byas na/sdug po mi yis gtong /skyid dus marga 'phang ma mtho/zug dus rang sems ma zhum/13
skyed dus rta la bzhon na rkub na/sdug dus kha sug log na glu btang /skyed pa'i dus su mi dang nyun mkhas dgos/0da 'dod rtsa gis po'i chung ma kyang/skyed sdug gan de mgo 'brel/skyid sdug sgang gshong mi snyom/skyen pa chu yin yang 'jal dgos/skyin pa chu yin yang sla ru ma thongs/skyur rma zhig dang ma 'phrad na/mngar mo tha3/sa cad cang cang red/skyug bro yang a ma'i rmā phor red/14
skye don med pa'i shing gcig la/bab don med pa'i bya gcig babs/skye ba yag ste :da mo dang /gdong pa bzang lta khrum khru / red/skye thengs ga ga la shi thengs gnyis/skyes pa'i mi la grags pa'i gtam dgos/byas pa'i las la grub pa'i mtha' dgos/che ba'i mi la mtho ba'i rtags dgos/9skyes nga'i drin las gsos pa'i drin che/skyon yod de 'dro4sa/sgal chad de 'phagskra rtse rlung gis bskyod kyang skra rtsa ka li la 'byar/skra bzhar zhor la kha sgyu thogs/15
skrangs pas 'byar len/sbangs pas chu len/bskal pa chags pa'i gangs ri las/rlung gis ded pa'i bye ri ma red/bskal pa'i yur bu la srid pa'i chu drangs pa las/dpe ngan gsar 'dzugs byas pa min/bskal pa bzang po'i ja 'dren de/dus tshod ngan pa'i khral la gyur/bskos pa'i las la zlog thabs med/dpal ba'i gnyer ma phyir/ thabs med/bskos pa'i mi dang btsugs pa'i shing /mngags pa'i mi dang 'phangs pa'i mda'/bskos pa'i mi de btsugs pa 'dra/btsugs pa'i shing de skyes pa 'dra/
nas lta pa yotsho45 pa mi rna la 'ji rgyastobkha ba babs par/ yagga shul nyi ma dro/kha ba babs na nyi sgrib dang /nyi ma shar na phu mda' med/kha btags ring ni gang yong dkar kha gtsang ba yag 'dugkha gtam g.yu 'brug skad las che/lag len nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar yal/kha bshad la nyi ma shar/lag len la mun pa rub/kha stong nang gi lce stong ༈lag stong nang yi/ phung stong ༈
kha bshad chu yi lhu ba/la4 ren gser gyi thigs/ nga/kha mkhus pas bu lon gsos dus med/rgyu 'dod pas sdig pa dag dus med/kha bde can gyis ci shod dang /dwangs kha can gyis ci za/kha brdo po mi yi ngapor po dang /lag bde po mi yi g.yog po yin/kha lang la shor ba'i glu chung de/pha a ma shi yang lhang lhang len/kha pho sngon dang lag len rjes/kha bde mos mi tshe mi 'khyol/kha la pad+ma'i lha khang bathengs/gting la dgo ru'i gcu phur nyar/18
kha 'jam gting gnag dug gi me togphyi 'jam nang rtsub bong bu'i yong ril/kha khras khras pags pa'i 'dzin phyogs/dga' mi dga' snying gi rtsa ba/kha dang khog pa drang po gyis/lus dang lag pa gtsang ma gyis/kha mang rgyad kyi rtsa ba/bya mang byur gyi sna 'dren/kha che ba las/nyen chung ba dga'/za kha rog bldad na kha mchu med/mgo rum du bcug na lhags pa med/kha mchu yul la med pa dang /rtsa ba rang la ma zug pa danas/
kha mchu mi 'dod gnam rdo sgor mo/bu lon mi 'dod sngon gyi lan chags/kha mchu zhag la lus na pho las mo mkhas/kha mchu dngul gyis rgyag pa la/bden pa dgos yas mi 'dugkha chad rgyag mkhan kha red/ri mo 'bri mkhan lag red/kha sna'i bar la rdzun lab/mdzub mo'i bar la ri bkab/kha nas tshig shor yu ba thung ༈yu ba thung la 'ju sa med/ga 'thab bar la lce mchu sdem/rdo rdung bar la mdzog man sdem/ 20
kha mchu to zur gsum cernga rdzun ma lab/lag mdzub mo bcu yis rku ma byed/ga bsangs na ka bde/nam gsal na 'gro bde/kha pho rus med kyang gong nga /ska rus pa med kyang krong krong /kha rin po che lus dal du chugs/kha rje la bu yod kyang /dbang thang la nu ma bskams/kha rog bsdad na bu mo lkugs ma zer/gnas lugs bshad na bu mo'i 'pher sha zer/ga ta lco bsnyal bsnyal la/chaca sgo chang langs langs/kha kho ga la phyi log bya rgyu med/slo ma log la phyi lob/ bya rgyu yod/
kha rma gso dka'/lag rma gso bde/kha ta nag po'i jig sgrib kyis/ngang pa ser po 'dam la zugkha rlangs shig gis dros/bya grib cig mas 'khyags/kha so gcig gis mi yi zhing bzas nas/kha so yongs kyis 'gro ba'i lam bu bkagkha zas spang nas bzas/rol ma nags su btang /kha tig gi ro ma myangs na/mngar mo'i ro ngo mi shes/kha mngar zhugs pa'i sems la gsal/byams sdang byis pa'i yid la yod/
kha la za 'dod na/lag pas las ka byed/kha za 'dod skyu tshogs 'khor dang /klu gtong 'dod skyu mgur/kha babs kyis me kha gsos par/= rig gi mang ja/kha dog dgon sar lo legs na/'dzam bu gling la ltas ngan/ṇa ma rabs kyis min min/lag ma rabs ༷sa skyong tsam skyong tsam/sta gang bltas la bkra mi shes/rgyab gang bltas la rtswa mi skye/kha shas bla ma bsams/kha shas gtor ma bsam /
kha nor lam nor gnyis de/nyes rdung gzed pa'i gzhi ma yin/kha ba mgo thog tu babs na/rbad mgos g.yab g.yab/kha dkar rkyang la kha lo med/bre ser 'brong la sna lo med/kha sa rna yag maskyong sar/de ring pa phas mchongs/kha brtsam la lta ring /rkub phro rog gis 'drus/kha ba nyin mtshan bco brgyad babs kyang /byi'u tso ka khra mo'i skad la 'gyur ba med/kha zur btsun mar bzhu rdzas/ṭam 9 brgya las lhag pa/
ga nang gi rma kha kha nang gsos/khyim nang gi ga rtsod khyim nang zhi/kha 'tshigs pa lag pas ma bzod/kha so pags pas mi 'dum/kha lugs 'ub sul mi sdud/khri ta bsad na pho rog skyo/khag 'dogs med par mi mi shi/khal bong bus 'khyer bar/rgya lam shed pa na dgos med/khal khur 'dug bsams nas steng rtsegs/'gros rgyag 'dug bsams nas yob rdung ༈khal gsum theg pa'i bong bu'i lus dang /nam tshod 'thing pa'i bya pho'i lus/25
khab rgyus mgar ba dang /chu rgyus mnyan pa zab/khab 'tsham mngags/spud pa dbugs mngags/khab shul skud pas ma khongs kyang ༈khab mig stong par ma lus pa/khab brlag dogs kyis gru gu dang /gru gyu brlag dogs kyis gdang la bkal/khab rlag dus tsha gi 8 gi/mdzo rlag dus 'ba' re 'bu re/khab mig gis nam mkha'i tshad 'jal/kham bu za 'dod ma red/skyur mo slong 'dod red/khas gong bar bshad/ dang bas cha gar bshad/cha gas sa gzhi khyab/
d+ku/ sa che/ ltar blangs/thebs chu ltar bcagkhas bya zin lag pas nya zin/khu ba dwangs khar mi 'gro yang /bag tsha zlos kyis mi gtong /kho nyen rang lag tu yod dus/blang dor gyi 'dems kha ma log pa dgos/kho 'dod kyi tshong dang ༈dang 'dod kyi bskor ba/khe 'dod na spu thogs/gcig shul la gnyis skyes/khog ma'i nang du ma lus pa dang /gzar bu'i ldebs la ma 'gos pa/[log ma la me tog legs kyang /mdzog man nas sad kyis khyer/23
khog la nad med na// dong la dreg pa chags don med/khog drod yod nas zhogs chu brgal/khong khro g.yag la za/rdog rgyag rta la gzhus/khyi bdag pos 'gog rgyu mgron po/gtam a phas gtong rgyu a mas/khyi bdag pos 'gog pa/lcags skam pas 'chun pa/khyi phru gyu gnyis kyis nye ngo shes/bya ri dwags gnyis kyis dgra ngo shes/khyi mi rmugs dka' med rku mas rna rdung /lda mi rgyal dka' med lha 'dres 'gram lcagkhyi rgan gas khug tshud na/mche ba mi 'don ka med/28
khyi mos cha/jug ma bsgril na/khyi phos rna cog skrur don med/khyi tan rus bzung dang /mi rgan mgo mkhregs/khyi gzhu gu bzang yang rang gi sna/khyi la 'tsho rgyu gzhu gu/khyi nyal sar mjug ma ma lus pa/khyi lha khang du 'dzul ba/zhal zas kyi ltags bla/khyi 'khyam mi ro zos zos kyis/bdag po'i gdong la lta jig jigkhyi ngan pas lung pa ku cas 'gengazakhrimi ngan pas yul sde phung la car/khyi ngan byung na bar ka sna la gzhus/
/ste 'a rgyug pa'i bkra shis shogkhyo rtsig khug la bkar na kha logkhyi nyams sprang pos lon nas rgyug pa phred bzer/chu nyams mnyan pas lon nas kau ba phred gtsad/khyi la seng ge'i ming btags/khyi tshe ring yang lo dgu/khyi shi na pho rog gi grogkhyi rus rga gsang nas shor/ma mar mchod gnas shor/khyi lag pa chag pa'i skad ngan/khyi la spags 3 sdig the/khyi dang nya na rma dang rnya/30
khyi ded na lam la mi 'gro/khyi'i mthong las med par ri'i 'khur/khyim mtshes du ba gdang 'brel/sgo phyogs bsgyur kyang thog 'brel/khyim mtshes zhe ldang med na/grong la yar rgyas med/khyis phar zug med par/gla phos tshur zugrjes nag bkar ba/ ririkhyed ༷ ma mthong shes bya mang /bong bus ma can lam 'phrang mang /khyed rgyus nga dang nga rgyus khyed/rgya phyug chung ma byang /bal 'jam snam bu legs/81
khyod skad sbom po brgyab kyang ༈nga nya phra mo chags skyu ma red/khyod rgya mtsho skam nus na/nga sbal pa shi mi nus pa med/khyod gyong po bkug pas mi gug pa zhig yin na/nga mnyen po bcag pas mi chag pa zhig yin/khyod la ngan pa dgu 'dzoms na/nga la bzang po bcu 'dzoms/khra chung mig la rdul dang /dam pa'i chos la rdzun/khra chung mig la skyon ma byung na/ltad mo chen po dnganas lta lta red/khra tshang 'og gi byi'u tshang /rgyal ba lnga pa'i 'khrung yul/
khra sngag can gyis byi'u ba da pa las/༷༷ jig med kyis 'bu ba gas pa mang /kham dang g.yo sgyu ma byas na/pho rabs thams cad zlo rtse gcigkhral la gser phye 'jal/kha la ram pa za/khral chad pa rgyal pos mi 'dum/ri lug pa thag pas mi 'dum/khral chag med pa'i bogs 'phar/khri gdugs nyi ma'i rang 'od la/me 'khyer srin 'bus 'gran ya byed/khri gdugs nyi ma kun la mdzes kyang / bya 'ug pa'i mig la de mi mdzes/khrims bzung rgyal po'i ṣā ba lan gcig yin/de las mang na rgyal sa 'dzin mi thub/
khrims len dpon gyi khrims rā la/bshad long nyan yong gnyis ka yod/khrims med dpon gyis byas na/gdung 'bod su la byed/khrims med dpon gyis byas na/ra mda' su la sbran/khrims khra mas bcad/sha sta gris gses/khrems sa'i tshig dang rgya mtsho'i sdo/khrims dang sdom pa rang srung /khrung khrung spu ris dkar na'ang /mjug gu'i rtse mo nag po red/khrung khrung ngalar po la/mjug rtse nag por ma song ba/
khrel dang ngo tsha bor nas gson pa las/bag yod tshul ldan ngang du shi ba dga'/khran pa'i nang gi sprul pa/khon pa'i nang gi rus zasrgya mtsho'i gtam gyis gi/mkhas pa ris su ma bor/spyi mi dgra ru ma len/mkhas pa yon tan can la nga mi skragblun po gti mug can la nga skragmkhas pa'i tshig gi zur/gnam lcags ral gri'i 'od/mkhas pas mkhas par sdang /'phyon mas 'phyon mar sdang /mkhas pas mkhas pa dang /dpa' bos dpa' bo mthong ༈35
'khar rnga 9 nas brdungs/dril bu nang nas dkrol/'khon med nyi ma then bral/'khyag pa ma mthong na/chu la gdung sems mi skye/mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar ser por mthong /rlung nad can gyis gangs ri thon por mthong /'khrug pa lha yi yul du 'khrugs/'dum pa srin po'i yul du 'dum/rbabga nas bltas kyang gnyen tshan/sgo phyogs log kyang thog 'brel/gang la rgyu nor ldan gyur na/dka' ba'i don yang lhan gyis grub/
gang skyed pha yul dang / ga casu byams ma ma res / ji ri gang drag bya ba ci drag zer/gros skyu 'dri sa thabs sdug la/gang dang gang la byed 'khyer dgos/skyag pa gtong bar 7 'khyer danas/gangs dkar seng gi'i g.yu ral la/khyi nag dom bu'i rnga mas 'gran/gangs sdod seng ge'i ga'i ral ngom pa la/sa 'og 'bu srin ya mkha3na skye don med/gangs dkar po zangam 'i gdan sa la/'brug pho thang yin yang gzur na dga'/gangs ri dkar po marapal gyur kyang /gri gzhog gcig gi re ba med 87
gar song sa na skyid pa med/gar bsdad sa na sdug pa med/gal po che la nan tan dang /dam pa'i chos la brgya tshar/go chod med kyang rga bkagshes rgyus med kyang lam rgyus/bo ba med pa'i glang rgan rargyal po'i bka' las dbyug pa btsan/ka rang gis ma chod/yid phyogs bzhir mugka rang gis ma chod/yus pha mar/gong dpon po'i dbu 'phang dgung las mtho/dayod ma sdug phu dung sa la drud/
